race.description: May Racing Carnival Now On Sale Hwt Hcp (Bm62)
race.comment: CROSSOVERKID (6) is the one to beat despite a plain ninth at this track on heavy ground last time, with his narrow Seymour second two starts back reading well for this. Well placed to bounce back to form. SHARE THE STARS (9) made the strongest recent statement when beaten a neck at this track at long odds and her overall consistency in the past 12 months makes her a clear danger back up for a second crack at 1700m. HEED THE OMENS (1) returns from a five-week let-up after a sound fourth at this venue and has the proven 1700m record to improve again. Can improve. NEWCOMBE (7) was posted wide at Bendigo in BM56 grade, so that tenth can be treated with some forgiveness and his nose second as favourite at Coleraine keeps him in the mix despite a tough gate for professor Pateman.
